semantic_lead: Optional semantic review by AI. It only runs when the project configures a provider and the run asks for it, and its conclusion stays apart from the deterministic decision.
semantic_off_hint: No provider is configured: JGates sends nothing to an AI provider. To turn it on, choose a provider in Edit (it goes to {key} in {file}).
semantic_configured_hint: Runs only when the run asks for it, with {flag}. Unavailability, timeout or an exhausted budget never approve or reject the core.
semantic_limits_value: {seconds} s per call, {calls} calls, {chars} characters of context
semantic_locked: Governed mode: the policy {policy} fixes the configuration, and the card only shows the values.
semantic_form_lead: The essential fields of {key} in {file}. Each change becomes a minimal patch of the file: comments and everything else stay as they are.
semantic_connections_none: No connection in your preferences yet.
semantic_advanced: Masking, prompts and the other advanced fields ({keys}) stay in the file. See the documentation in
semantic_unchanged: The chosen values are already in the file; nothing was saved.
semantic_h_enabled: Unchecked, it writes enabled: false and turns the semantic gate off without removing the rest. Inherited, it is on whenever there is a provider.
semantic_h_provider: A provider of the semantic gate or the name of a connection of your preferences. Without a provider, the semantic gate is off.
semantic_h_model: Inherited, the default model of your preferences for the provider or the connection applies.
semantic_h_scope: changed: the changed files; full: the whole project; paths: only the chosen paths.
semantic_h_paths: The paths reviewed when the scope is paths.
semantic_h_timeoutSeconds: Limit of each call to the provider; when it runs out, the review is unavailable and does not change the decision.
semantic_h_maxCalls: How many calls a review may make (one per context chunk).
semantic_h_maxContextChars: Characters of context sent to the provider, in total.
semantic_h_baseUrl: Optional: a team gateway for the whole project. Inherited, the one of your preferences or of the provider applies.
